g.text: You put the letter in an envelope with the sender’s and recipient’s name, address, and post code.

g.title: Sheet.1367
g.desc: The postal service knows exactly where to deliver the letter....
g.text: The postal service knows exactly where to deliver the letter. It reaches the right person, and if needed, can be sent back.
